description.description: A close-up side profile of a costumed character resembling Dr. Doom, wearing a metallic mask, an olive green hooded cloak over intricately detailed plating, chainmail-like sleeves, and silver metal gauntlets. The image is covered by a repeating red watermark grid.

A medium shot of actor Chris Evans as Steve Rogers from the film Avengers: Infinity War, standing in a profile view against a plain gray background. He has long hair and a beard, wearing a tight black t-shirt and charcoal tactical pants with a belt. Red watermark text is layered repeatedly across the entire image.
